correctness.rationale: At the j-th selected position, the number of preceding unselected letters is even because the source and selected word alternate in the same phase. Thus no deletion can split the two letters of a paired residual block. Its type is the parity of the number of selected letters already read. With type zero at both boundaries, each run of ba blocks needs two parity changes, each costing a selected letter. Conversely one selected letter at each change and all remaining letters appended in pairs builds the required alternating source. The 2j endpoints of j runs choose 2j of r+1 gaps; Pascal's identity gives the second sum. The maximum run count ceil(r/2), the fixed-k leading term, and k=0 or r=0 agree with the statement. A separate recursive embedding enumeration matched the entire sets in all 66 cases 0 <= k <= n <= 10, totaling 1068 distinct residuals across cases. This finite replay is corroboration, not the proof.

evidence: The exact fiber theorem gives positive multiplicity precisely for paired residuals with transition number T at most the deletion length d (appending a parity-dependent last symbol only when the residual length is odd).
broader_coverage.reasoning: Use host length 2n and deleted length 2k, with a,b relabelled 0,1. The residual is even, both endpoint types are zero and T is twice the number of ba runs, giving the frozen condition exactly. The broader result also counts every embedding with that residual.

The November 2 record has the same all-parameter complement language, two binomial sums and saturation threshold; the November 22 record independently supplies a dominating claim at the statement level by classifying positional multiplicities for all alternating prefixes. This is a finding of equivalent catalogue coverage, not a finding of earlier publication or copying: both identified catalogue paths are later than the frozen October 18 path.
residual_risks: No claim of historical priority is made; catalogue dates and mathematical equivalence do not establish a chronology of discovery. Earlier unindexed equivalents were not excluded.
